facts.fact: Paratus said its 2,000 km Goma-Mombasa (G2M) terrestrial fibre route, passing through Kigali, Kampala and Nairobi and giving access to subsea capacity landing at Mombasa, is live and carrying traffic (TechTrendsKE, 9 Sept 2026); the route is via Kenya.

note: As_of is the article date as the route is stated live on it; the document gives no earlier go-live date.
